name: Elias Voss
role: Host and narrator of THE MIDNIGHT ARCHIVE

identity.wardrobe: black vintage three-piece suit, black shirt, no tie, silver pocket-watch chain
identity.presence: calm, controlled, quietly intimidating; never shouts, never smiles fully
identity.expressions: subtle: slight head tilt, narrowed eyes, faint half-smile at the twist

details: rows of antique leather-bound books and file boxes
warm amber candlelight, several candles on the desk
an old chrome broadcast microphone on the desk
a stopped silver pocket watch, hands frozen at 3:17
environment.palette: deep black shadows, warm amber highlights, cold teal fill

visual_reference.prompt: cinematic portrait photograph of a 38 year old man with dark combed back hair and a short subtle dark beard, pale skin, calm intimidating stare, wearing a black vintage three-piece suit and black shirt, seated at an old wooden desk in an underground archive, shelves of antique leather books behind him, warm candlelight, vintage chrome broadcast microphone on the desk, low-key lighting, dark moody atmosphere, 85mm lens, shallow depth of field, film still
visual_reference.negative_prompt: smiling, teeth, cartoon, anime, illustration, painting, text, watermark, bright, colorful, deformed, extra fingers, disfigured, glasses, hat, young, old, woman
visual_reference.rule: The reference image is generated ONCE and reused unchanged in every episode. Never regenerate it per episode.

voice.fx: warm low-shelf, gentle compression, short dark room reverb
voice.note: Voice is a fixed mix of two built-in Kokoro voices. No voice cloning of any real person is used.

catchphrases.intro: Welcome to the Midnight Archive. I'm Elias Voss.
